verdict.rationale: Remote is an HR/payroll platform that could plausibly ship user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: webhooks that push events, a scriptable CLI with JSON/CSV output, and MCP tools invoked on demand by an AI client. It also shows one adjacent feature, invoice auto-pay. None of these is a documented product capability for setting up autonomous, recurring automations or agent runs in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
